Title: Amazon River Dolphins
Content: Amazon River dolphins live mostly in fresh water. They live in the Amazon River in South America. Figure `1` shows the life cycle of the Amazon River dolphin.
Amazon River dolphins live in groups of up to `text(six)` dolphins. These groups help the dolphins survive. These are some things Amazon River dolphins do in groups:

:ibox:• hunt together
• take turns eating and watching for predators
• make groups around their young to protect them
• whistle and click to talk to one another
